rule_verbatim: the pattern replicates in population p if (a) mean < 0 with its interval excluding zero AND (b) mean < 0.0040 AND |(c) mean| ≤ 0.0040 (the fixed thresholds). The paper may say the routing result holds across the five generated populations only if it replicates in all four new ones; otherwise it reports each population and names where it holds or fails.
interval_scope: Pointwise paired t intervals; no multiplicity adjustment. Within-population intervals describe training/split-seed variation.
fixed_reference: Frozen population 0, κ=1, full-population organ ranges, unchanged from E1B.
